SAHU s COMPANIES, operating through a robust network of associated firms including M/s - Om Enterprises, M/s - Sahu Associates, M/s - G. S. Enterprises, M/s - Sahu Enterprises, and M/s - U. K. Associates, is identified as a highly experienced and geographically extensive industrial services provider across India. The group demonstrates substantial operational capabilities, maintains long-standing client relationships with major industrial players, and possesses a proven track record of driving efficiency and resolving complex challenges within demanding environments, particularly prevalent in the cement and heavy infrastructure sectors.

The core strengths of the Sahu s Companies are rooted in its deep specialization in contract labour supply, cement packing and loading, operations and maintenance, mechanical, electrical and civil projects manpower solutions, and a distinguished ability to navigate challenging labour relations while consistently achieving quantifiable improvements in productivity and cost efficiencies.

With legacy roots established by Late Mr. Ram Narayan Sahu, currently led by Mr. Omprakash Sahu, an MBA professional with over 20 years of industry experience, the group stands for reliability, compliance, and industry-leading performance across more than 18 locations nationwide.
To be India’s most trusted, innovative, and agile partner in industrial contract services.
To be the one-stop solution for all cementing manpower and plant-support needs across India. Mission:
Deliver comprehensive manpower and operational excellence.
Ensure statutory compliance and absolute safety.
Drive sustainable growth for our clients and communities.
Driven by Experience. United by Vision.
